[P2] Preserve lower-bound semantics when reducing precision

`Date.parse` truncates sub-millisecond digits, so `since: "2026-10-23T18:42:46.784119Z"` becomes `.784Z`. Aurora and Redshift now include an execution starting at `.784000Z`, although it precedes the requested bound; previously their native timestamp comparison preserved this distinction. Preserve fractional precision for typed destinations. When converting bounds to millisecond text, round a non-aligned `since` upward and `until` downward. Add a boundary test asserting that records before the original `since` remain excluded.
